configuration.experimental_prefix_cache: disabled: existing snapshots are single-context-rank only

capacity_probe.scope: test-only exclusive capacity probe; normal performance cases retain natural EOS

limitations: Sustained 32K native case fails throughput, per-stream speed and scheduled TTFT. Dispatch-only TTFT is not end-to-end latency.
API cases use an isolated Modal router with real production authentication, atomic rate admission and billing. They exclude the production custom-domain route and an arbitrary client WAN.
Actual 350K output remains unqualified until the capacity probe returns 350000 sampled tokens and length finish reason. The probe uses test-only EOS suppression.
